review.notes: Full review of README (3348 lines) and Suggested.lean (23 headline theorems). Gate: worker gate.md all pass; rerun all 0 except outside-folder=24, all in the PR's own folders (brief exclusion diff empty). depcheck: 238 roadmaps, 2350 edges, 0 problems. lake env lean: 23 sorry warnings only; #check audit of all 23 declarations matches README; probes show cerf_theorem closes from smale_conjecture (padding), and that Thurston's irreducible inequality, Agol's aspherical virtual Haken theorem and Yazdi's infinite family are statable at the pins (absent). Seeded sample of 15 targets checked against cached texts (livingston2005, hatcher-3m, scharlemann2002, li2013, calegari2007, yazdi2016, manolescu2016, agol2013, km2004, gmm2009, watanabe2018, hatcher-at, piccirillo2020) and against the roadmap's own extracts on main; paywalled or uncertified locators listed as not verifiable. P1: 6.2 even-valued signature claim refuted by the README's own trefoil Check (copied Livingston error); 10.3 dual norm placed on a quotient instead of the annihilator. P2: Thurston's inequality needs connected surfaces; Moise's Hauptvermutung misstated as a common subdivision; two statable headlines absent. P3: one false Check, a missing Needs item, padding, locators, conflicting open revisions (#903, #1517, #1791) with no stated order, style.
